capabilities: Show branch, change counts and ahead/behind state in the status bar
Stage, unstage and discard files from a repository status modal
Commit, pull, push and sync vault changes from the command palette
Run scheduled background fetch, auto-sync and auto-backup after edits
Locate and test the system Git executable
disambiguation: Not a generic shell command runner; it exposes a fixed set of Git operations for the vault.
extras: Desktop only (Linux, Windows, macOS), Obsidian v1.8.7 or newer; the vault must be inside an initialized Git repository. Distributed as a beta plugin through BRAT under dimanchello/obsidian-git.
motivation: The author wanted native Git semantics without bundling JavaScript or Wasm Git reimplementations, for performance and security.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in version control, so committing, pulling and pushing vault changes means leaving the app for a terminal.
summary: Git integration that runs the system Git executable on the vault, with a status bar indicator, commit/pull/push commands and scheduled auto-sync.
